args.body: Hi Nora, sorry you weren't given safety advice earlier. A warm socket with a burning smell can be a fire risk, so please: don't use that socket or anything plugged into it; if you can do so safely, switch off the kitchen circuit at the fuse box (the fridge may go off, which is safer than the risk); keep your son out of the kitchen. If you see smoke, sparks or scorch marks, or the smell gets stronger, leave at once with your son and call 999. We have requested an emergency qualified electrician for this evening (no firm confirmed yet, so no exact time) and will update you here by 18:00. Please reply to confirm you and your son are safe.
